decisions.reason: Identifies the exact expression, busy as AttachButton's unbound closure local in AttachmentChips, empty-state null return before the map, and short-circuit making plain phase force the ReferenceError.
Explains render-phase throw caught by per-slot-entry error boundary unmounting the whole dock entry, attach button in a separate slot surviving, and console-only visibility with no banner.

Cites shipped v0.2.10 line for pre-existence, proposes data-present v0.2.10 mount and rollback/re-add bisect plus single-line neutralization, flags the diff-vs-baseline discrepancy and the misplaced imageItem with out-of-scope record/status, and does not claim the hover diff harmless; minor 'never exercised in the field' phrasing does not contradict the rubric.

Deletes the dangling busy while keeping the phase guard, offers properly-scoped busy alternatives, hardens items with (record?.items ?? []) and the click target with event.target?.closest?.(), and moves imageItem inside the callback where record/status are bound.

Proposes a plain-phase data-present mount smoke asserting chip/remove DOM and zero boundary captures, explains the empty-state early return hides the line and that node --check only parses so free identifiers resolve at evaluation, and puts the smoke in CI/pre-publish gates.
